This shows participation while keeping control. - **"I'm happy to contribute in another way!"** Offer to help with something else: "I'd love to help coordinate the seating or bring a special dish instead of buying fabric." This shifts focus to meaningful contribution. - **"I need to check my budget first"** (if you're not ready to say no outright) This buys time to reflect. Often, when families hear "I need to check my budget," they realize it's not a simple request and may soften their stance. ### A gentle truth to hold onto: > **"Family traditions should uplift you, not drain you.
